# Helping you launch, grow, and locate your business in the Ann Arbor area.

Ann Arbor SPARK drives economic development, growth, and prosperity by supporting entrepreneurs and established businesses looking to expand in the southeast Michigan region.

[Launch or Grow Your Startup](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/) [Expand Your Business Here](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/)

## Spark Services

### We are a community resource that drives economic prosperity by helping businesses of all sizes achieve their growth goals.

[Learn more about Spark services](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/)

Startup Services

Supporting early-stage, tech-related companies in the cities of Ann Arbor and Ypsilanti.

- [Entrepreneur Boot Camp](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/entrepreneur-boot-camp/)
- [Startup acceleration](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/startup-acceleration/)
- [SPARK Coworking](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/coworking/)
- [Coaching & Mentorship](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/coaching-mentorship/)

Business Expansion

Connecting existing companies to the critical resources they need to locate, stay, and grow here.

- [Site Selection Consulting](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/site-selection-consulting/)
- [State and Local Incentives](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/state-and-local-incentives/)
- [Talent Acquisition](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/talent-acquisition/)
- [Industry Connections](https://annarborusa.org/resources/connections-resources/)
- [Municipality Support](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/municipality-support/)

Find Space

Helping businesses discover their next office, R&D center, and lab space in the Ann Arbor region.

- [Commercial Listings](https://annarborusa.org/listings/)
- [Site Selection Consulting](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/business-expansion/site-selection-consulting/)
- [Spark & Incubator Space](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/incubator-programs/)

Funding

Investing in early-stage tech startups and helping grow the state’s angel investor community.

- [Idea Stage](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/funding/idea-stage/)
- [Startup Stage](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/funding/startup-stage/)
- [Growth Stage](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/funding/growth-stage/)
- [Mature Stage](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/funding/mature-stage/)

## Helping 2,000+ companies turn their vision into reality

### SPARK Entrepreneurial Services can help shorten the time required to attract capital, talent, customers, and other strategic resources.

With funds earmarked by the MEDC and budget oversight by the Ann Arbor/Ypsilanti SmartZone Local Development Finance Authority, SPARK’s entrepreneurial programs, services, tools, and resources support the growth of a vibrant startup ecosystem.

[Startup Acceleration \\
\\
Grants and programs designed to expedite key milestones.](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/startup-acceleration/) [Entrepreneur Boot Camp \\
\\
Founders validate their ideas and develop a path forward.](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/entrepreneur-boot-camp/) [Capital Programs \\
\\
Investing in southeast Michigan’s innovative startups.](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/funding/) [Coaching & Mentorship \\
\\
Experienced entrepreneurs guiding founders to success.](https://annarborusa.org/spark-services/startup-services/coaching-mentorship/)

[Learn more about SPARK](https://annarborusa.org/about/)
